test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the Benn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes?

Solar system, Planet, Universe
solution:
The diagram that best represents the relationship between the given classes is shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec581ff6ccfca245bb9867fedd0fdcb584038f5326f9aaa96a0d338f6b9e8291.png] 

Planet is a subset of the Solar System, as planets exist within the Solar System.

Solar System is A subset of the Universe.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Universe: Includes the Solar System and all planets.

Solar System: A subset of the Universe, containing planets, the Sun, moons, and other celestial objects.
